newsitem.title: USA: Ancor says Sequent reseller pact canceled.
newsitem.headline: Ancor says Sequent reseller pact canceled.

text.p: Ancor Communications Inc on Monday said its 1996 original-equipment manufacturing contract allowing Sequent Computer Systems Inc to resell one of its switches had been canceled.

The original two-year pact called for an Ancor Fibre Channel switch to be used as the high-speed interconnect between the NUMA-Q processors and RAID storage device arrays, Ancor said. The contract was valued at $6 million for the first year of commercial shipments.
The two companies said they would continue to work to integrate Fibre Channel technology with Sequent's new-generation NUMA-Q compute and storage systems.
